description: Add a fixed-strategy discrete population recursion mode with answer-free survivor selection, auditable budgets, existing-mode compatibility, and a separately blocked real LAB improvement validation.

userStories.title: Discrete strategies and budget primitives
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want deterministic population strategies and explicit budget helpers so that experiments are reproducible and auditable.
acceptanceCriteria: Add harness2/core/population.py with fixed strategy generation, donor selection, component crossover, lineage records, and pop budget helpers.
Identical task/mode/k/version/slot inputs reproduce identical strategies across calls and generations.
Crossover returns a new Tree without mutating input Trees.
The deterministic schedule assigns one extra crossover trial per slot across two generations and exactly 3k total trial rollouts.
Tests prove R=4k, P=2k+2, P=3k at k=2, and P<3k at k>2.
Typecheck passes using the repository's Python 3.12 compile/import validation.
Focused unittest validation passes.

userStories.title: Answer-free batch survivor comparison
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want one anonymous comparator call per generation so that survivor selection has a quality signal without using a benchmark judge.
acceptanceCriteria: Add batch comparison support in harness2/core/selection.py and harness2/core/prompts.py with unique generation roots and session labels.
The comparator receives anonymized task/source/artifact evidence and returns one explicit winner for every requested slot.
Invalid trials, missing winners, parser failures, and comparator exceptions preserve the relevant parent and are recorded.
Multi-generation calls do not delete each other's context or collide in the Proposer cache.
Tests prove adapter.score is never called and comparison costs and attempts are returned for Ledger recording.
Typecheck passes using the repository's Python 3.12 compile/import validation.
Focused unittest validation passes.

userStories.title: Two-generation population recursion
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want a complete population recursion implementation so that fixed strategies can evolve Harnesses under a bounded budget.
acceptanceCriteria: Add run_population and pop dispatch in harness2/core/recursion.py while leaving agg/seq behavior unchanged.
Each generation freezes parents, generates and executes all trials, then performs batch survivor selection without early survivor writes.
Record fixed strategies, parents, donors, trials, survivors, surrogate fitness, comparison outcomes, and lineage in ModeResult.
Update harness2/core/ledger.py for mode-aware budgets and include comparison sessions, costs, and attempts.
Tests cover budget identities, invalid proposal retry, failed-trial parent retention, exactly k final labels, and judge isolation.
Typecheck passes using the repository's Python 3.12 compile/import validation.
Focused unittest validation passes.

userStories.title: Scheduling, final selection, Library, and resume integration
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want population mode to use the existing task lifecycle so that results and experience remain consistent with other modes.
acceptanceCriteria: Update schedule.py and selection.py to pass the existing selector into population recursion and actual final labels into final-pool construction.
Preserve agg/seq call signatures and final pools; pop explicitly permits a surviving base label and records it as base.
Chosen trees, materialized Harnesses, fingerprints, summaries, and selection records work for every survivor label including baseN.
Per-mode Libraries remain isolated and restored Libraries contain only earlier tasks from the same mode.
A complete second run adds no execute/Proposer calls; changed adopted Harnesses or missing adopted artifacts cause a rerun.
Typecheck passes using the repository's Python 3.12 compile/import validation.
Focused unittest validation passes.

userStories.title: CLI, run identity, and reporting
userStories.description: As an experimenter, I want consistent CLI and reporting support so that population runs cannot be confused with other experiments.
acceptanceCriteria: Update mode parsing and help in cli/_common.py, cli/run_sweep.py, cli/demo.py, and cli/judge.py as applicable.
population and pop resolve to the same token; defaults and Demo both do not gain a new mode.
Population with k<2 fails before model calls with an actionable error.
Add an independent population strategy version to config.py and include it in identity only for population runs.
Update core/report.py so pop finals and base survivors are classified honestly and k=1 agg/seq logic never assumes every two-mode report contains both.
CLI dry-run, namespace, judge/report parsing, and old-default regression tests pass.
Typecheck passes using the repository's Python 3.12 compile/import validation.
Focused unittest validation passes.

userStories.title: Deterministic end-to-end Demo and documentation
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a credential-free end-to-end check and accurate documentation so that the new mode can be verified without external services.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend harness2/demo.py so scripted strategies produce distinguishable edits and batch comparisons select valid outputs using source evidence without a benchmark judge.
python -m harness2.cli.demo --k 2 --mode population completes two real-Python tasks, writes all population audit records, and resumes without new calls on repeat.
Update README.md and docs/EXPERIMENTS.md with mode behavior, budgets, base-survivor semantics, resume boundary, citations, and judge isolation.
Full unittest suite passes and existing agg/seq Demo behavior still passes.
Documentation does not claim real LAB improvement.
Typecheck passes using the repository's Python 3.12 compile/import validation.

userStories.title: Same-budget LAB comparison and independent evaluation
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want a preregistered LAB comparison so that population mode is accepted only if it improves independent test performance within budget.
acceptanceCriteria: BLOCKED until a supported Linux host, LAB dependencies, model credentials/quota, executor network restrictions, and a user-approved sample/cost cap are available.
Before execution, record the split, task stream, seed, models, sample size, cost cap, and stopping rule; test results cannot be used for repeated tuning.
Run parallel,population together at k=2 on the same tasks so base executions, models, judge, and network policy are shared.
Verify actual population rollouts and sessions do not exceed parallel budgets and no judge ran during optimization.
Run independent harness2-judge and harness2-report; save scores, ungraded rows, actual costs, timings, and failures.
Mark passed only if independent population test score exceeds parallel without exceeding the agreed budget; otherwise leave failed and record the negative result.
Typecheck passes using the repository's Python 3.12 compile/import validation for any code changed by this story.
